about.sectionTitle:
We build the software
a business runs on.
about.sectionSubtitle: LaunchLume is a five-person product studio in Hyderabad. We shipped paid client work before we called ourselves a studio.
about.story: We were paid to build before we called ourselves a studio. LaunchLume started with five of us studying at NIAT. Through the Brave program we took on real client work — not coursework, not concepts — and delivered more than ₹8 lakh of it before we ever registered a company. That order is the whole point. Most studios start with a name and go looking for proof. We had the proof first: shipped products, paid invoices, clients who came back. So the five of us still sit at one table in Hyderabad. We take fewer projects than we could, stay close to every decision, and ship software people actually use.

faq.q: What makes your development process different?
faq.a: We work in short, transparent milestones with regular demos and updates, so you’re never left wondering about progress. You’ll always know what’s being built, what’s coming next, and have opportunities to provide feedback throughout the project.
Most engagements begin within two to four days. A focused Shape sprint is often the fastest way to align scope, team, and technical direction before a larger build.

faq.q: Do you work with existing product teams?
faq.a: Yes. We frequently embed with internal teams, take ownership of a workstream, or provide a complete senior squad. The operating model is shaped around your capability gaps.

faq.q: How much does a typical project cost?
faq.a: Every project is different, so we don’t use fixed pricing. After a discovery call, we’ll provide a detailed proposal with scope, timeline, milestones, and pricing—so you know exactly what you’re paying for. No hidden costs or surprise invoices.

faq.q: Can you support the product after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We offer focused optimization periods and longer-term product pods for teams that want continuity through adoption and scale.
